# s4communication_communication_system (Resource)

Manages an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Communication System. Attributes that are not configured are set by SAP and kept as computed values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "s4communication_communication_system" "example" {
  communication_system_id = "EXT_API_SYSTEM"
  name                    = "External API System"
  description             = "External API integration"
  host_name               = "api.example.com"
  tcp_port                = 443

  owner_contact_person_name  = "Jane Doe"
  owner_contact_person_email = "jane.doe@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `communication_system_id` (String) Communication System ID (user-provided identifier)
- `name` (String) Communication System Name

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 and later: import with the resource identity, as listed by
# terraform query
import {
  to = s4communication_communication_system.example
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Communication system UUID

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Communication systems are imported by their UUID
terraform import s4communication_communication_system.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
